oracle: Ensembl VEP 115.2 with Ensembl 115 GFF3 and GRCh38 no-alt FASTA

fields.name: Existing_variation
fields.reason: The source-matched GFF lane deliberately has no co-located-variant source.

fields.name: REF_ALLELE
fields.reason: Both implementations derive the minimized reference allele from the same submitted VCF record.

fields.name: UPLOADED_ALLELE
fields.reason: Both implementations derive the unminimized allele pair from the same submitted VCF record.

fields.name: SYMBOL_SOURCE
fields.reason: The public Ensembl GFF3 supplies gene symbols but not VEP cache symbol provenance.

fields.name: HGNC_ID
fields.reason: The public Ensembl GFF3 does not contain the VEP cache HGNC cross-reference.

fields.name: MANE_SELECT
fields.reason: The public Ensembl GFF3 identifies MANE Select membership but does not contain the paired RefSeq accession. This lane validates membership from the GFF tag and does not qualify the legacy fastVEP value as a RefSeq accession.

fields.name: MANE_PLUS_CLINICAL
fields.reason: The public Ensembl GFF3 identifies MANE Plus Clinical membership but does not contain the paired RefSeq accession. This lane validates membership from the GFF tag and does not qualify the legacy fastVEP value as a RefSeq accession.

fields.name: APPRIS
fields.reason: The public Ensembl GFF3 does not provide the APPRIS metadata present in VEP caches.

fields.name: CCDS
fields.reason: The public Ensembl GFF3 contains ccdsid, which fastVEP retains, but official VEP 115.2 GFF mode does not project into its internal _ccds field; validate directly against the pinned GFF3.

fields.name: SIFT
fields.reason: Protein predictor data is outside the source-matched GFF consequence lane.

fields.name: PolyPhen
fields.reason: Protein predictor data is outside the source-matched GFF consequence lane.

fields.name: SOMATIC
